text_block_list.text:
—Hanshin Racecourse was buzzing with 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Is that... the problem child, Agnes 
Tachyon? What an unbelievable way to run.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't take my eyes off her for a 
second. Her potential is the real 
deal...!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
... I have to admit, you certainly have 
the skill.

...After that, the spontaneous applause 
that broke out was unquestionably directed 
toward Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(Oh my, it sounds rather noisy outside. 
Applause, and... my name...?)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(...Hmph. Seems you managed to put in a 
decent run.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
“—And, well, well, Guinea Pig-kun! How was 
it? My sprint, that is!”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, you can tell just by looking, 
right? There isn't a single flaw.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Just as I declared to you, I'll make it 
through the Senior Class without a hitch."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
“Indeed. But the real experiment starts 
now, Guinea Pig! The horizon beyond our 
limits lies far ahead!”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I have only just set sail in a proper 
craft. I will go even further!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—And to get there, the role of a "Trainer" 
is an absolute necessity.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So, with that in mind, the next race is 
the Takarazuka Kinen. It'll be 200 meters 
longer than this one.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Which means improving both the lactate 
threshold and lactate tolerance is 
essential.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And so, behold the new drug I pulled an 
all-nighter to whip up! Ta-da!

With that said, she pulled a fluorescent 
pink liquid from her pocket and pressed it 
into my hand.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My body is a national treasure. Which 
brings us to your turn, my dear guinea 
pig.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A battle-tested guinea pig like you 
shouldn't be fretting over mere colors at 
this point. Hehehe!

She was as pushy as ever, pressing me 
with, "Go on, drink it right now," but—

Even so, the applause echoing from outside 
refused to die down for a long time.
